newsitem.title: USA: NPC on target for opening 12 Tony Roma's.
newsitem.headline: NPC on target for opening 12 Tony Roma's.

text.p: NPC International Inc said the company remains on target to complete a planned 12 new Tony Roma's restaurant openings this fiscal year.
The company operates 412 Pizza Hut restaurants and delivery kitchens. Through Romacorp Inc, it operates and franchises 172 casual-theme Tony Roma's restaurants.
Earlier Thursday, NPC posted December 24 third-quarter earnings of $0.15 a share compared to $0.16 a year earlier. Sales declined to $73.7 million from $77.7 million.

It said earnings were hurt by increased cheese costs and negative comparable sales in its Pizza Hut division, and increased labor costs in its Tony Roma subsidiary due to normal labor inefficiencies associated with new store openings.
NPC said it expects cheese costs to remain at or below prior-year levels for the balance of the fiscal year.
